title: EconoServe: Maximizing Multi-Resource Utilization with SLO Guarantees in LLM Serving
technique: predicted-RL batching + KVC pipelining, multi-resource utilization maximization under SLO

optimized_metrics.evidence: EconoServe maximizes multi-resource utilization while ensuring service-level objective (SLO) guarantees
EconoServe increases throughput by up to 4$\times$ with the same level of latency

headline_claim.text: EconoServe increases throughput by up to 4$\times$ with the same level of latency, generates up to 91\% lower job completion time and up to 91\% higher SLO satisfaction ratio compared to vLLM

extractor_notes: Abstract-only extraction. Utilization of GPU compute and KV cache is the stated objective; throughput unit not stated. GPU count reduction at equal goodput also reported.
